entity_raw.definition_raw: You have altered your understanding of a select number of spells. Prerequisite(s): Spell Mastery, Stylized Spell, Bluff 5 ranks, Spellcraft 5 ranks. Benefit(s): You do not modify the spell slot used when applying the Stylized Spell metamagic feat to any spell you have mastered with Spell Mastery. Normal: A stylized spell uses up a spell slot 1 higher than the spell’s actual level.
